answer: Because the entropy is measured at the lagoon gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the crystal audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 3 bits per word is rejected before grading, since it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. A farm emitting 196 variations of one paragraph thus forfeits for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the atlas panel. That is 25 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
